steps.name: check_modem_power
steps.description: Check if the user's modem is powered on
steps.next_action: IF modem_on (the modem is powered on) THEN go_step_4 ELSE notify_turn_on_modem (ask the user to turn it on)

sub_steps.name: ask_modem_power
sub_steps.description: Ask the user whether the modem is on or off
sub_steps.next_action: IF modem_off (the modem is currently off) THEN user_turn_on_modem ELSE go_step_4 (continue to next step)

steps.name: check_modem_settings
steps.description: Check modem settings and guide the user to review them
steps.next_action: IF settings_ok (settings are correct) THEN go_step_3 ELSE guide_user_fix_settings (help user adjust settings)

steps.name: check_sim_card
steps.description: Check for a faulty or problematic SIM card
steps.next_action: IF sim_fault (SIM card is faulty) THEN replace_sim_and_go_step_5 ELSE go_step_4

steps.name: operator_network_check
steps.description: Check the operator’s network status and area signal strength
steps.next_action: IF network_issue (operator or signal issue) THEN go_step_5 ELSE close_case (issue resolved)

steps.name: final_operator_escalation
steps.description: Final escalation to the operator if the issue persists after all steps; inform the user that the problem has been forwarded to the operator for further investigation and requires patience

steps.name: vpn_check
steps.description: Check VPN status as it may cause connectivity issues
steps.next_action: IF vpn_on (user says 'on' or 'yes') THEN stay_in_current_step_and_ask_user_turn_off_vpn ELSE IF vpn_off (user says 'off' or 'no' or 'turned off') THEN go_step_2

steps.name: ping_test
steps.description: Perform a network connectivity test using Ping and guide the user on how to do it
steps.next_action: IF ping_failed OR ping_unreachable OR ping_timeout OR no_ping THEN go_sub_step_1 ('name':check_config_modem )  ELSE go_step_3 (ping successful, continue)

sub_steps.name: check_config_modem
sub_steps.description: Write a short beginner-friendly guide to check modem config to see if it is connected or not
sub_steps.next_action: IF ok_config or success_config THEN go_step_4 ELSE go_step_5

steps.name: check_internal_external_links
steps.description: Test access to internal and external links to determine the type of issue
steps.next_action: IF both_down (both internal and external links fail) THEN go_step_5 ELSE IF both_up (both working) THEN go_sub_step2 ELSE IF internal_ok_and_external_fail THEN go_step_5 ELSE IF external_fail THEN go_step_5 ELSE IF just_internal_ok THEN go_step_5 ELSE IF both_up_but_slow or both_up_but_late THEN go_step_5 ELSE go_step_5

sub_steps.name: both_down
sub_steps.description: If both are down, reset the modem or escalate to the operator

sub_steps.name: both_up
sub_steps.description: If both are connected , ask the user which link is problematic and escalate to the operator

sub_steps.name: internal_ok_external_fail
sub_steps.description: If internal links work but external links fail, escalate to the operator
sub_steps.next_action: IF user_says_external_sites_down (user says 'External site not opening' or 'Only internal opens' or 'External fragment' or 'External not coming' or 'YouTube or Google not opening') THEN go_step_5 ELSE IF user_says_internal_sites_down (user says 'Internal site not opening' or 'Only external opens' or 'Internal fragment') THEN go_step_5

sub_steps.name: both_up_but_slow
sub_steps.description: If both are active but slow, ask the user to check modem configuration

steps.name: check_modem_lights_and_hardware
steps.description: Check the number of lights on the modem (none, one, two, or more) to identify the hardware or signal issue level

sub_steps.name: no_lights_on
sub_steps.description: If no lights are on, check the power source or adapter
sub_steps.next_action: IF user_says_problem_fixed THEN end_task ELSE IF user_says_one_light_on THEN go_to_sub_step_2 ELSE IF user_says_two_or_more_lights_off THEN go_to_sub_step_3 ELSE go_step_5

sub_steps.name: one_light_on
sub_steps.description: If only one light is on, check the SIM card or antenna
sub_steps.next_action: IF problem_fixed (user says 'درست شد' or 'مشکل حل شد') THEN end_task ELSE IF user_says_two_or_more_lights_off (user says 'دو تا چراغ خاموشه' or 'چند تا خاموشه') THEN go_to_sub_step_3 ELSE IF one_light_on (user says 'یه چراغ روشنه' or 'هنوز یه چراغ روشنه') THEN go_step_5 ELSE go_step_5

sub_steps.name: some_lights_off
sub_steps.description: If two or three lights are off, check the WAN or LTE connection
sub_steps.next_action: IF problem_fixed THEN end_task ELSE go_step_5

steps.name: final_operator_escalation
steps.description: Final escalation to the operator if the issue persists after all steps; inform the user that the problem has been forwarded to the operator for further investigation and requires patience

steps.name: check_config_modem
steps.description: Write a short beginner-friendly guide to check modem config to see if it is connected or not
steps.next_action: IF ok_config or success_config THEN go_step_4 ELSE go_step_5

steps.name: check_DNS
steps.description: Write a short beginner-friendly guide to check DNS to see if it is connected or not
steps.next_action: IF ok_DNS or ok or success_dns or good THEN go_step_5 ELSE stay_current_step_and_fixed_problems
